metadata.name: Antarctic Snow Depth and Density Observations (Dec 2021 – Jan 2022)
metadata.description: Point measurements of snow depth (total, top, bottom) and snow density collected at 578 locations in Antarctica. Each record includes an event identifier, latitude, longitude, a UTC timestamp, and the measured variables.
metadata.spatial: point locations with ~0.1 m precision (≈7 decimal places in latitude/longitude)
metadata.temporal: sub‑second timestamps recorded over a 29‑day period
